general.q: Why should I choose Royal Clouds for hosting?
general.a: Royal Clouds runs on pure SSD storage with LiteSpeed web servers and Cloudflare CDN, making sites up to 15x faster than traditional HDD hosting. Every plan includes free SSL, a 1-click app installer, daily backups and genuinely friendly 24/7 support, all backed by a 99.99% uptime SLA and a 30-day money-back guarantee.

general.q: Do you offer a money-back guarantee?
general.a: Yes. All shared, WordPress and reseller hosting plans come with a 30-day money-back guarantee, so you can try Royal Clouds completely risk-free.

general.q: Can you migrate my existing website for free?
general.a: Absolutely. Our team migrates your website, databases and emails from your current host for free, with no downtime. Just open a ticket after signing up and we'll handle the rest.
Yes, every hosting plan includes a free SSL certificate that is automatically installed and renewed, so your visitors' data is always encrypted.

general.q: What payment methods do you accept?
general.a: We accept all major credit and debit cards, UPI, net banking and popular online wallets through our secure billing portal. Invoices renew automatically and you can cancel anytime.
Our hosting specialists are available 24/7/365 via live chat, email and support tickets, with most chats answered in under a couple of minutes.
